start_here: Say to your AI: "Stop the programs you picked as left running." with the picked list. It runs tool:stop-programs-left-running, which asks each to end, waits up to ten seconds, and answers one stop per program and one notice when any ended.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and answers, and keeps no row.
instructions: 1. Grant the tool read-processes and close-apps on this computer.
2. Give programs, the picked list tool:choose-programs-left-running answered; nothing else is stopped.
3. Read each stop's outcome, keep the stops where you keep such rows, and tell the person the notice if there is one.
